output.review_comment: The pull request adds significant new logic (holiday observation shifting) that appears to be test-specific accommodation rather than spec-driven implementation. The holiday observation behavior—shifting Saturday holidays to Friday and Sunday holidays to Monday—is completely new and undocumented in the visible docstring. Before merging, please: (1) Update the docstring to document the holiday observation behavior if it's part of the agreed spec; (2) Provide a PR description explaining why these changes fix the failing tests; (3) Verify the loop boundary change (start+ONE_DAY with day <= end) matches the intended interval semantics; (4) Share evidence that the failing tests now pass with these changes.
